prices_csv.description: Optional absolute path to an offline adjusted-close CSV (date, stocks, benchmark). Empty uses Yahoo Finance. No simulated fallback.

exposes_tools.name: barra.series
exposes_tools.description: Read already-computed daily research metrics in the current Track for native chart.series blocks. BARRA:Beta, BARRA:Momentum, BARRA:ResidualVol are window-cumulative factor regression coefficients in percentage points, NOT tradable strategy returns. BARRA:Forecast and BARRA:Realized21D are annualized volatility percentages; BARRA:EqualWeight is the study-start-100 gross equal-weight reference index. Only fields=[close], period=day. No market fetch or calculation is triggered. Frozen mode conservatively excludes the latest result date to honor the host's completion contract.

exposes_tools.name: barra.start
exposes_tools.description: Start or update a daily US price-factor study in the current Track. Beta, momentum and residual volatility only; NOT MSCI Barra. Defaults to a fixed illustrative 30-stock universe and SPY benchmark, with selection/survivorship bias. Queues an immediate calculation and future daily updates; the background worker downloads public Yahoo data. No trades or model-generated code. Configuration changes are refused during an active calculation. No Track id argument.

symbols.description: US Yahoo ticker symbols, uppercase. All must have sufficient complete history.

exposes_tools.name: barra.status
exposes_tools.description: Read the current Track's study configuration, phase, error and latest successful summary. Does not fetch market data. The output states data date and scope limitations.

exposes_tools.name: barra.refresh
exposes_tools.description: Queue one recalculation for the current Track. The background worker subsequently fetches data; this call only queues work. Concurrent refreshes coalesce. A stopped study must be started first.

exposes_tools.name: barra.stop
exposes_tools.description: Disable daily updates for the current Track and clear pending work. A calculation already in progress may finish internally; if stopped before publication its output is discarded. Existing published results and files are retained.
